# Faction quest seeds

Legacy quest ideas grouped by faction. They are seeds, not runtime content: a quest becomes real only as a validated quest package with a board task ([`QUESTS.md`](../QUESTS.md), [`SYSTEMS/QUESTS.md`](../SYSTEMS/QUESTS.md)).
